title: Yogurt Caprese Parfait
description: A simple and healthy dessert or snack made with yogurt, tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, and basil.
instructions: Layer 1/2 cup yogurt in a glass or parfait dish.
Arrange 1-2 slices of cherry tomatoes from the Caprese kit on top of the yogurt.
Add 1-2 slices of mozzarella cheese from the Caprese kit.
Sprinkle some chopped fresh basil leaves on top.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with the yogurt on top.
Garnish with additional basil leaves if desired.
